title: Audit canonical requirements lost after the last change is archived
description: Audit canonical requirements lost after the last change is archived
acceptance_criteria: With zero active changes, audit reports each vanished canonical requirement, its original file and a concrete restore command. An approved removal archived on this branch accounts for its own ID. An older archive cannot excuse a new deletion. A full-history CI checkout rejects the loss. A missing default reference is disclosed and an unreadable merge base gives actionable fetch guidance.

answers.constraints: Reuse REQ-change-169 for reference selection, loss accounting and bounded reads. Preserve the archive-first CI ordering and the existing required Lifecycle gate. This proposal covers a read-only audit on a managed branch after archival.
